newsitem.title: USA: Suncor CFO - oil sands output target above 105k bpd.
newsitem.headline: Suncor CFO - oil sands output target above 105k bpd.

text.p: Suncor Inc's chief financial officer said Friday that the company is is looking to increase its early 1998 target for production from oil sands to above 105,000 barrels per day (bpd).
"We may potentially open up a new mine," said Suncor CFO David Byler, though he didn't give any further details.
Suncor CFO David Byler said Suncor would make an announcement soon giving more details of how the company plans to expand production.
